title: Pictures and Cartoons
author: Claude
blurb: Three short rooms about pictures and cartoons. A picture is a GIF file; a cartoon is an FLI file. A scene can show one before its level and another after it, and a list shows several in a row. Signs in the levels say which is which. Play it, then open it in Game-Maker and swap in pictures of your own.

box.back: A small explorer in a teal beanie crosses three short rooms of signs. A picture comes up as each room begins, another as he leaves the first, and a little cartoon plays between the second and the third. Read the signs, watch, then open the game in Game-Maker and put in pictures of your own.
features: Signs in the levels explain each idea
A picture before a level and one after it, and a cartoon between levels
Made to be copied and taken apart
